item.title: What Is AI Security? Protecting Models, Data, and Systems from Emerging Threats
item.description:
📄 Source: MindGard Blog
👤 Author: Fergal Glynn | 📅 Date: October 8, 2025
AI Security Cybersecurity Machine Learning
AI security is a specialized field focused on protecting machine learning and generative AI systems from evolving threats such as data poisoning, prompt injection, and model theft, which traditional cybersecurity tools cannot fully address. It requires full-lifecycle strategies including clean data, access controls, continuous monitoring, and adversarial testing to safeguard AI models and data throughout their lifecycle. As AI becomes integral to enterprises, new security challenges demand proactive approaches beyond conventional defenses.

item.title: 10 Top AI Security Risks (and How to Defend Against Them)
item.description:
📄 Source: MindGard Blog
👤 Author: Fergal Glynn | 📅 Date: October 8, 2025
AI Security Cybersecurity Artificial Intelligence
The article discusses the rising security risks associated with the rapid adoption of AI technologies in business operations, highlighting unique vulnerabilities such as data poisoning, model inversion, and AI-driven cyberattacks like deepfakes and phishing. It emphasizes the need for specialized AI cybersecurity measures, including securing training data, continuous monitoring, and ethical governance, to mitigate these threats effectively.

item.title: Function calling in LLMs: Testing agent tool usage for AI Security
item.description:
📄 Source: Giskard Blog
👤 Author: Giskard Team | 📅 Date: 2023-09-28
Artificial Intelligence Large Language Models Software Testing
The article discusses the function calling feature in Large Language Models (LLMs), which enables them to invoke external functions or APIs to create more dynamic and interactive AI applications. It highlights the importance of testing agents in validating function calls and emphasizes the security challenges such as injection attacks and unauthorized access, recommending rigorous testing and security measures to ensure safe AI operation.
